title: 1.3 Applications of Information Systems
description: E-Government, E-banking, E-learning, E-commerce, Telemedicine and Teleconference

questions.question: What is e-Government?
options: Business registrations, auto registry, payment of taxes, issuance of birth certificates, and issuance and renewal of identification cards
Digital devices required to perform core information system functions such as data storage, data processing, and communication
The use of information systems to provide electronic services to citizens with the purpose of increasing efficiency, transparency
Patients who were in remote places, far away from local health facilities, or in areas with shortages of medical professionals
questions.correctAnswer: The use of information systems to provide electronic services to citizens with the purpose of increasing efficiency, transparency

questions.question: What is a portal?
options: A web-based information system that collects information from different sources into a single user interface
The operating system, the Database Management System (DBMS), application software, and anti-virus software
Online training, providing data entry and processing services, Internet Cafe service, and online product sells
What data should be captured, who should have access to the data, and who should have the privilege to modify data
questions.correctAnswer: A web-based information system that collects information from different sources into a single user interface

questions.question: Which of the following municipal services can be automated and made accessible for citizens over a web portal?
options: Automatic Teller Machine (ATM), Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, Credit cards, Debit Cards, Smart Cards in the situation described
Digital devices required to perform core information system functions such as data storage, data processing in the situation described
Business registrations, auto registry, payment of taxes, issuance of birth certificates, and issuance and renewal of identification cards
Patients who were in remote places, far away from local health facilities, or in areas with shortages of medical professionals in the situation de
questions.correctAnswer: Business registrations, auto registry, payment of taxes, issuance of birth certificates, and issuance and renewal of identification cards

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of adopting e-government solutions?
options: Requiring citizens to go to municipalities in person
Establishing trust between governments and citizens
Stopping the sharing of information between agencies
Increasing the cost of running government services
questions.correctAnswer: Establishing trust between governments and citizens

questions.question: With e-government services, customers can pay their monthly electric bill through which device?
options: Their mobile phones
A horse and cart
A landline telegram
A paper coupon
questions.correctAnswer: Their mobile phones

questions.question: What does the traditional banking service demand of customers?
options: Operating at unlimited travel speeds in dense urban pedestrian zones
Going to the bank in person and waiting their turns to get a service
A robot vacuum cleaner that cleans floors without human intervention
Open-flame heating braziers placed beneath wooden auditorium benches
questions.correctAnswer: Going to the bank in person and waiting their turns to get a service

questions.question: What is electronic banking?
options: A form of technology-based banking service that avoids exchange of cash, checks, or other types of paper documents
A set of interrelated components working together to collect, process, store, and disseminate information to potential users
The practice of caring for patients remotely without the caregiver and the patient being in the same physical location
What data should be captured, who should have access to the data, and who should have the privilege to modify data
questions.correctAnswer: A form of technology-based banking service that avoids exchange of cash, checks, or other types of paper documents

questions.question: In the banking sector, IT is mainly associated with which services?
options: Prohibit gallery visitors from viewing physical exhibits in daylight
Overriding municipal traffic lights during peak commute travel hours
Automates the genetic modification of endangered agricultural plants
Internet banking, Automated Teller Machine (ATM), and mobile banking
questions.correctAnswer: Internet banking, Automated Teller Machine (ATM), and mobile banking

questions.question: Which of the following are commonly known e-banking services?
options: Business registrations, auto registry, payment of taxes, issuance of birth certificates, and issuance and renewal of identification cards in the situation described
The use of information systems to provide electronic services to citizens with the purpose of increasing efficiency, transparency, and citizen participation
The use of information systems to provide electronic services to citizens with the purpose of increasing efficiency, transparency in the situation described
Automatic Teller Machine (ATM), Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, Credit cards, Debit Cards, Smart Cards, and Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) System
questions.correctAnswer: Automatic Teller Machine (ATM), Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, Credit cards, Debit Cards, Smart Cards, and Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) System

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of e-banking?
options: The cost of operation per unit of services is lower for banks
Replacing grain agriculture with synthetic laboratory pellets
Conducting oral language examinations in secondary classrooms
Hospital bed construction, cafeteria catering, and laundering
questions.correctAnswer: The cost of operation per unit of services is lower for banks

questions.question: With e-banking, customers can withdraw cash at any time using which service?
options: ATM service
A street vendor
A post office counter
A money lender
questions.correctAnswer: ATM service

questions.question: Which of the following is a challenge of e-banking?
options: Network speed
Large capital
Digital theft
Daniel Bekele
questions.correctAnswer: Digital theft

questions.question: What is e-learning?
options: The assortment of decorative font typefaces in HTML stylesheets
A form of learning delivered through the use of digital devices
Overcoming geographical barriers to access health care services
In alphabetical dictionaries listing grammatical language terms
questions.correctAnswer: A form of learning delivered through the use of digital devices

questions.question: Which of the following terms is also used to describe e-learning?
options: A meeting of two or more people who are separated by distance using electronic communication
Online learning, virtual learning, distributed learning, and computer-based learning
A technology creating a three-dimensional computer-generated simulated environment
Interrelated Internet-connected objects exchanging data without human intervention
questions.correctAnswer: Online learning, virtual learning, distributed learning, and computer-based learning

questions.question: If e-learning is provided over the Internet, what is it referred to as?
options: Online learning
Street learning
Paper learning
Market learning
questions.correctAnswer: Online learning

questions.question: Which of the following are the main components of e-learning?
options: An individual who creates a new business, bearing most of the risks and enjoying most of the rewards
The Internet, computers or mobile phones, digital learning resources, content developers, and learners
Recruitment, demographic, performance management, learning management, and compensation and benefits data
The operating system, the Database Management System (DBMS), application software, and anti-virus software
questions.correctAnswer: The Internet, computers or mobile phones, digital learning resources, content developers, and learners

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit that e-learning offers to learners?
options: High travel expenses
Flexibility in learning time
Physical isolation from resources
Fixed class schedules
questions.correctAnswer: Flexibility in learning time

questions.question: Which of the following is a disadvantage of e-learning?
options: A system simulating conversation through text or voice commands
The process of designing, launching, and running a new business
A physical bulletin board posted in municipal community offices
Physical isolation of students from teachers and other students
questions.correctAnswer: Physical isolation of students from teachers and other students

questions.question: What is e-commerce?
options: Stationing armed security personnel outside branch cash vaults
The buying and selling of goods and services over the Internet
Total deforestation, slash-and-burn clearing, and wood burning
Automatic manufacturing of custom replacement electronic goods
questions.correctAnswer: The buying and selling of goods and services over the Internet

questions.question: E-commerce is fundamentally which of the following?
options: A website deployed over the Internet to handle online transactions
Acts as the orbital rocket booster for station orbital adjustments
Locating objects of focus and showing overlaid digital information
IT is transforming the way young digital entrepreneurs do business
questions.correctAnswer: A website deployed over the Internet to handle online transactions

questions.question: Which actors are involved in e-commerce transactions?
options: Job creation that could help tackle global unemployment
Merchants, buyers or customers, banks, and transporters
Using, operating, and maintaining an information system
A network router directing data packets between subnets
questions.correctAnswer: Merchants, buyers or customers, banks, and transporters

questions.question: Avoiding intermediaries in e-commerce allows customers to do what?
options: Buy products directly from manufacturers at a cheaper price avoiding wholesalers and retailers
Create and manage an information system that is supportive to the organization's daily activities
An understanding acquired by further processing and integrating different sets of information
A meeting of two or more people who are separated by distance using electronic communication
questions.correctAnswer: Buy products directly from manufacturers at a cheaper price avoiding wholesalers and retailers

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of e-commerce?
options: Higher prices from local merchants
Decisions about the type of vehicles to buy
Increased bargaining power for the customer
Limited access to global markets
questions.correctAnswer: Increased bargaining power for the customer

questions.question: What is telemedicine?
options: A set of interrelated components working together to collect, process, store, and disseminate information to potential users
The practice of caring for patients remotely without the caregiver and the patient being in the same physical location
Digital devices required to perform core information system functions such as data storage, data processing, and communication
Patients who were in remote places, far away from local health facilities, or in areas with shortages of medical professionals
questions.correctAnswer: The practice of caring for patients remotely without the caregiver and the patient being in the same physical location

questions.question: Telemedicine was originally introduced to treat which group of patients?
options: Patients who were in remote places, far away from local health facilities, or in areas with shortages of medical professionals
A set of interrelated components working together to collect, process, store, and disseminate information to potential users
Digital devices required to perform core information system functions such as data storage, data processing, and communication
Business registrations, auto registry, payment of taxes, issuance of birth certificates, and issuance and renewal of identification cards
questions.correctAnswer: Patients who were in remote places, far away from local health facilities, or in areas with shortages of medical professionals

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of telemedicine for patients?
options: As binary machine-code commands stored on optical compact discs
A system simulating conversation through text or voice commands
Converting assembly language mnemonics into binary machine code
Overcoming geographical barriers to access health care services
questions.correctAnswer: Overcoming geographical barriers to access health care services

questions.question: What is a teleconference?
options: An understanding acquired by further processing and integrating different sets of information
Buy products directly from manufacturers at a cheaper price avoiding wholesalers and retailers
Create and manage an information system that is supportive to the organization's daily activities
A meeting of two or more people who are separated by distance using electronic communication
questions.correctAnswer: A meeting of two or more people who are separated by distance using electronic communication

questions.question: What are the two popular forms of teleconferencing?
options: Paper conferencing and mail conferencing
Audio conferencing and video conferencing
Telephone conferencing and postal conferencing
Street conferencing and market conferencing
questions.correctAnswer: Audio conferencing and video conferencing
